business_problem: The City of Copenhagen had to calculate salaries for 30,000 annual hires under dozens of labor agreements, hundreds of salary grades, and wage subsidies. Manual interpretation was slow and created a risk of overpayment.
solution_summary: The city added ServiceNow AI Agents to its existing HR Service Delivery platform to interpret candidate résumés and recommend salary ranges under a governed workflow. The AI reads résumé information in different formats and applies relevant employment rules, while deterministic calculation logic performs the exact mathematical steps so results remain traceable. Recruiters review each recommendation before an offer, and payroll specialists handle exceptions and compliance rather than manually processing every document. During the pilot, up to eight specialists checked calculations, reported errors, and helped refine prompts and knowledge articles; the regular user group later grew to 30. The design keeps humans responsible for decisions and uses scripted logic when computation should be deterministic. The source does not identify a model or résumé-storage architecture.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow HR Service Delivery
solution_components.role: Hosts the employee and payroll service workflow used to process HR cases.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow AI Agents
solution_components.role: Interpret résumé content and recommend applicable salary ranges for recruiter review.

data_flow: Candidate résumés enter the HR workflow; AI agents interpret employment history and applicable rules, deterministic logic calculates salary figures, and recruiters verify recommendations before offers are made.
business_outcome: Salary calculations fell from 10 minutes to under two minutes. The city reports saving 3,000–4,000 hours in the simplest cases and redeploying 2.5 FTEs to higher-value work while keeping human review of recommendations.
